newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore noon shares steady, upside limited.
newsitem.headline: Singapore noon shares steady, upside limited.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was steady at midday on Wednesday, underpinned by Wall Street's extended gains.
However, dealers said uncertainty over whether Wall Street's recent gains were sustainable capped upside potential here.

The Straits Times Industrials Index was up 0.80 points at 2,056.48 after hitting a morning low of 2,054.80. Turnover was an active 65.17 million shares, with 114 gainers and 154 losers. Creative Technologies led the gainers, rising Singapore $1.50 to S$24.70 after analysts upgraded the earnings prospect of the multimedia company.

Disk drive component maker MMI continued to benefit from Uraco's link to CAM International Holdings, which is under fraud investigations. The shares hit a new year high of S$0.745 before easing to S$0.71 on over five million shares.

Pacific Andes hit a new year high at US$0.815 before easing to US$0.795 on about three million shares. Dealers said no news surrounded the activity but the frozen seafood company was among the small capitalised stocks being fished.
Others included fruit seller FHTK and Datapulse Technology, which was among top percentage gainers, rising more than seven percent to SS$0.65. -- Angela Tan (65 8703083)
